authority: Owner amended global rule: Trainer difficulty has no home field advantage; Ace Trainer five-turn home field advantage; Pro Trainer full-match home field advantage. Owner specified first two Gym home fields can only be changed by something of the same type; the others cannot be changed. Interpreted as Roark weather and Gardenia terrain exceptions, with custom Gym home fields protected.
scope: All eight Gym Leaders, retroactive and prospective. Supersedes previous Pro-exclusive five-turn home-field rule; all approved teams, species, moves, items, level caps and field effect identities otherwise preserved.

unchanged.initial_activation: battle start, no action or PP cost
unchanged.normal_weather_and_terrain_slots: Roark and Gardenia use their corresponding native slots; custom home fields must be protected against overwrite and removal while active; native coexistence routing to verify

maylene_ai: Pro Trainer custom field persists through entire match; Ace Trainer field expires normally at five turns. Preserve Sneasler Pro-exclusive bait and same attacking battler repeated move requirement.
native_holds: Implement difficulty routing and permanent-duration representation without sentinel collisions; verify weather/terrain ownership, activation, move history, suppression, removal/replacement and reset on battle exit once interaction policy is approved.
Test both innate modes and existing field/weather effects; rebalance Ace Trainer teams with five-turn fields and Pro Trainer with permanent fields; no unauthorized roster changes.

Verify direct removal rejection, cross-category coexistence, same-category weather/terrain replacement, no hidden reapplication, custom-field protection and normal battle reset; do not alter native semantics until explicit unresolved cases are reviewed.

revision.scope: home field replacement and removal policy

replacement_policy.scope: Ace Trainer and Pro Trainer while home field active; Trainer has no automatic field
replacement_policy.interpretation: same type means same field category, not Pokemon elemental type. Ordinary weather and terrain replacement lasts according to the replacement effect's own duration; no automatic return proposed, consistent with prior no-reapply rule. Other field category does not overwrite home field. Future Gym fields protected by default unless owner explicitly changes rule.
replacement_policy.unresolved_native_details: suppression vs removal (e.g. Cloud Nine), same-effect refresh, custom field coexistence with ordinary weather/terrain, and exact replacement expiry semantics require native QA or explicit owner ruling if ambiguous.
